heading: Traceability & Eco FAQ
subtitle: Transparent supply chain information and carbon footprint specs.

questions.question: Is the garment 100% carbon-offset from raw material to delivery?
questions.answer: Yes, we offset 100% of carbon emissions through certified Gold Standard reforestation projects in South America.

questions.question: What water recycling standards are enforced at the dye mill?
questions.answer: Our Italian dye mill utilizes a Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) system, recycling 98% of process water.

questions.question: Are non-toxic OEKO-TEX dyes utilized?
questions.answer: Certified OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Class 1, free from heavy metals, formaldehyde, and AZO colorants.

questions.question: How are fabric off-cuts repurposed?
questions.answer: 100% of cutting table fabric scraps are shredded and spun into interior thermal insulation batting.
